entries.land_location_as_stated: on an old blue stone quarry with a lovely, secluded pond
entries.description: Lesbian separatist homestead of 3 lesbians on 45 acres at an old blue stone quarry with a pond in Saugerties, NY. Raises most of its own food with gardens, a solar greenhouse, goats and poultry; supports itself through outside jobs and summer Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives; working on wheelchair accessibility. Welcomes lesbian women of all ages as visitors for up to five days for a donation.
entries.raw_text: ROWDYBUSH FARM (Susun Weed & Clove), 3136 Fishcreek Rd, Saugerties, NY 12477. Our dream is to be part of a network of SAFE SPACES for wimmin. Right now we are a hard working lesbian separatist homestead on an old blue stone quarry with a lovely, secluded pond. We provide almost all our own food with three large gardens,a solar greenhouse, dairy goats, chickens, ducks and fruit trees (to be planted this spring). We support the land partly by working outside jobs and partly by holding Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives every summer. We are working on wheelchair accessibility for house and campsites. We welcome lesbians of all ages as visitors for up to five days, $2-5/day donation. We have/are: 3 lesbians, 45 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, wimmin living and working on the land.
entries.notes: contact_name taken from the names in parentheses after the community name, '(Susun Weed & Clove)', read as the contact people. Land = mailing street address (road address, people live there). Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: 3 lesbians living on the land ('3 lesbians... wimmin living and working on the land'). num_residents 3 from questionnaire count with 'wimmin living and working on the land'. Accepted: Lesbian women ('We welcome lesbians of all ages as visitors'); 'SAFE SPACES for wimmin' is a dream statement, not a welcome, so Non-lesbian women not coded. Focuses: Lesbian separatism ('lesbian separatist homestead'); Farming/self-sufficiency ('We provide almost all our own food'); Workshops/education ('holding Herbal and Psychic Healing Intensives every summer'); Disabled women ('working on wheelchair accessibility for house and campsites'). Solar greenhouse mentioned only as part of food production, not coded as Environmentalism; psychic healing not coded as Spirituality since presented as a fundraising intensive.

entries.description: Women's land in its 6th year on 150 acres near Alpine, NY, between Ithaca and Watkins Glen, with 6-10 lesbians living there. Moving toward more focused land use, investing in farm equipment and needing work energy; healing is a focus for many. Cautiously welcomes visitors, new members and girl children.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805 (607)594-3536. (Between Ithaca & Watkins Glen, NY.) Northwoods is in its 6th year as womyn's land, now moving this spring to a more focused use of the land than just gardening and living. We're investing in farm equipment and need work energy. Healing is a focus of many of us. We need everyone here to be self sufficient and self motivated. We welcome: visitors (maybe), new members (perhaps, cautiously), girl children. We have/are: 6-10 lesbians, 150 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Land = mailing address (rural route 'RD 1'). Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: 6-10 lesbians living on the land. num_residents 6 is the smaller figure of the range '6-10 lesbians', with 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted: Lesbian women (questionnaire listing, lesbians living there; 'visitors (maybe), new members (perhaps, cautiously)'), Girl children ('girl children'). Focus Farming/self-sufficiency: 'investing in farm equipment' and 'need everyone here to be self sufficient'. 'Healing is a focus of many of us' noted; not in vocabulary.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in a hollow on a creek in the mountains of WV
entries.description: Two lesbians building a women's homestead on 25 secluded acres in a mountain hollow on a creek near Jumping Branch, WV, reached by foot or 4-wheel drive. They are carpenters, a woodworker/blacksmith and farmers who will teach skills to serious apprentices. Visitors welcome if they help and bring food; welcomes girl children and apprentices.
entries.raw_text: MISTY BOTTOMS FARM c/o Mimi & Judy, Rt 86 Box 15A, Jumping Branch, WV 25969. We are building a womyn's homestead on 25 acres in a hollow on a creek in the mountains of WV. Secluded land, access by foot or 4-wheel drive. We are carpenters and woodworker/blacksmith as well as farmers. Will teach skills to serious apprentices. Visitors welcome and expected to help (bring own food). We welcome: girl children and apprentices. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 25 acres, housing/permanent structure, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Land = mailing address (rural route 'Rt 86'). Type Private/Individual Land by the two-woman rule ('c/o Mimi & Judy', '2 lesbians'); taking apprentices and visitors does not change it. num_residents 2 from '2 lesbians' with 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted: Lesbian women (lesbians living there), Girl children ('girl children'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('building a womyn's homestead', 'as well as farmers'); Workshops/education ('Will teach skills to serious apprentices').

entries.description: Collective of seven lesbians caring for 40 acres near Holly Springs, MS, striving toward self-sufficiency, with a communal kitchen, permanent structures in process, outdoor plumbing, electricity and RV hook-ups. Not separatist. Visits by work exchange or cash; welcomes girl and boy children, non-lesbian women, and leashed dogs.
entries.raw_text: SILVER CIRCLE FARM c/o Gwen O Demeter, Box 100 Rt 5, Holly Springs, MS 38635. We are a collective of seven wimmin dedicated to caring for 40 acres and each other. We strive to tolerate our differences as well as enjoy them. We are striving toward self sufficiency. Visits require work exchange and/or cash for short stays. Longer visits/meals negotiable. Have communal kitchen. We are not separatists. We are spiritual, artistic, scientific, political, but most important we are loving wimmin trying to give each other space to grow! We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs (but only on leash). We have/are: 7 lesbians, 40 acres, permanent structures (in process), outdoor plumbing, electricity (also hook-ups for couple of RV's), camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Land = mailing address (rural route 'Rt 5'). Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: 'a collective of seven wimmin'. num_residents 7 from '7 lesbians' with 'wimmin living and working on the land'. Accepted: Lesbian women (lesbians living there), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl and Boy children ('girl and boy children'); dogs welcome on leash. Focus Farming/self-sufficiency: 'striving toward self sufficiency'. 'We are not separatists' noted; separatism not coded. 'We are spiritual, artistic, scientific, political' is a passing self-description, not coded as Spirituality/ritual.

entries.description: Family of 6 lesbians, 4 living on 18 acres near Red Rock, TX, 35 miles SE of Austin, developing a self-sufficient space to provide most of their food and some income. Plans include livestock, garden, orchard and a stained-glass and spinning workshop. Short visits for a fee or work exchange; no drugs, alcohol or cigarettes; welcomes girl children and dogs.
entries.raw_text: EARTH CURRENT FARM Rt 1 Box 137L, Red Rock, TX 78662 (512)764-2706. We are a family of 6 lesbians, 4 on the land. We are developing a self sufficient space 35 miles SE of Austin, that will provide most of our food and bring in at least part of our survival money. Our plans include chickens, goats, sheep, rabbits, a garden, orchard, and a stain-glass and spinning workshop. We welcome: girl children and dogs (maybe leashed). Visits limited to 2-3 days, $2 per person or work exchange, no drugs, alcohol or cigarettes please. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 18 acres, 2 housing/permanent structures, electricity, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Box number read as '137L' (slight print mark on the 7). Land = mailing address (rural route 'Rt 1'). Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: 'a family of 6 lesbians, 4 on the land'. num_residents 4 ('6 lesbians, 4 on the land'). Accepted: Lesbian women (lesbians living there), Girl children ('girl children'); dogs maybe leashed. Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('self sufficient space... will provide most of our food'); Recovery/substance-free ('no drugs, alcohol or cigarettes please'); Archives/cultural work (planned 'stain-glass and spinning workshop').

entries.land_location_as_stated: deeply forested, sub-alpine beauty at 3200'; near incredible Yuba River
entries.description: Lesbian couple in their 40s living on 13 deeply forested sub-alpine acres near the Yuba River in California, with a trailer, shed, well, organic garden and orchard. Seeking 1-3 semi-collective members and lesbian buyers for nearby parcels; welcomes new members, girl and boy children, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: CEDAR c/o Linda or Sara, PO Box 274, Camptonville, CA 95922. We are a couple in our 40's, vegies/non-smokers, living on 13 acres, deeply forested, sub-alpine beauty at 3200'. Looking for 1-3 semi-collective members, very hard to make a living locally, rural, quite isolated, wet winters, hot summers, near incredible Yuba River, other parcels for sale nearby and looking for lesbian buyers. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 13 acres, trailer, shed, electricity/well, camping space, woods, organic garden/ orchard, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: PO box is not the land; land_state CA inferred because land is described as local ('making a living locally', 'near incredible Yuba River'); no land city given. Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: a couple already living on the land ('living on 13 acres') actively recruiting members ('Looking for 1-3 semi-collective members'), the exception to the two-woman rule. num_residents 2 from '2 lesbians' with 'women living and working on the land'. Accepted: Lesbian women (lesbians living there), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl and Boy children ('girl and boy children'). 'vegies/non-smokers' describes the couple, not a substance rule; organic garden is a questionnaire item only; no focus coded.
